query: Every weekday before standup, pull yesterday's failed CI jobs, group them by owning team, and post a short digest in #engineering. Skip the post when there were no failures.
Can you keep an eye on the Stripe dispute feed and alert Mei if a dispute over $5,000 arrives? We can use their webhook.
next friday at 4pm come back to this launch checklist, verify every owner has signed off, then send me the gaps
I want a Monday-morning customer-health report with churn risks, expansion signals, and links to the source conversations.
Watch https://status.example.com and tell #ops when the incident changes from investigating to resolved; checking every two minutes is enough.
When a GitHub pull request in heliohq/helio gets the ready-for-review label, summarize the diff and tag the code owners.
Our nightly inventory automation is sending duplicate alerts. Inspect its recent runs and fix the procedure without changing its webhook URL.
Please pause auto_7f3 for the holiday, show me its last five runs, and update the SOP so empty reports stay silent.
hourly-ish, check the partner API for new settlement files and validate their totals; only message finance when a file is new or invalid
After the migration window closes tonight, verify row counts and failed records, write the result to a document, and share it with the database team.
Summarize the support tickets in this CSV right now and give me the top three themes.
Create a calendar event called Release Readiness for Tuesday at 10am and invite the mobile team.
Draft the wording for a reminder to Alex about the design review, but do not schedule or send it.
Explain what workflow automation means and compare Zapier with n8n for a small marketing team.
Write a one-off GitHub Actions workflow that runs unit tests on pull requests. Save it as .github/workflows/test.yml.
Look at the failed release job on my screen and diagnose why it broke. Don't set up ongoing monitoring.
Draft an SOP for how a human support agent should escalate refund requests; we are not scheduling or executing it yet.
Run the existing data-quality script once now and paste the output here.
Add a due date of Friday to HEL-914 and assign it to Travis.
Review this cron expression and tell me whether 0 9 * * 1-5 means weekdays at nine; don't create anything.
